description: A diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that measures the trained recommender’s behavior and produces an interpretation prompt grounded in observed metrics and explicit metric definitions. It preserves the SASRec compatibility interface while allowing architecture changes.
motivation: Guide model improvements using reproducible diagnostics while distinguishing observed interaction behavior from unavailable review data and unobserved simulator traits. Select improvements using the benchmark’s macro-average validation HR@10 across all four datasets.
implementation_notes: Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Access the actual trained network through view.model and adapt feature and scoring probes when the architecture changes. Batches contain (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B×L tensors. Derive diagnostics only from public interaction histories, titles, descriptions, timestamps, and model outputs; report unavailable information explicitly. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Preserve dataset routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, GAGC_DATA_DIR access, and trial-local artifacts. Architecture changes must also update the predictor writer. Host validation remains authoritative: 200 users per category, 99 unique negative candidates, evaluation seed 42. Do not access hidden test data.
pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe(view, device):
    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        under no_grad:
            inspect valid, non-padding batch positions
            compute supported model and interaction diagnostics
            generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations
                for five real training users per category
            aggregate measured diagnostics with explicit denominators
        restore model training state
        return {metrics, metric_definitions}

function diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    identify unavailable data and unobserved traits
    request evidence-grounded interpretations and improvement hypotheses
    specify macro validation HR@10 as the selection criterion

originality.positive: Connects model diagnostics, explicit evidence boundaries, and simulator-compatible recommendations within a shared evaluation contract.
originality.negative: Primarily an interface and diagnostic workflow; it does not specify a new recommendation architecture or learning objective.

future_potential.positive: Could support systematic architecture comparisons and more targeted model revisions across multiple datasets.
future_potential.negative: Its value depends on whether measured diagnostics predict useful improvements; diagnostic associations alone do not establish causes.

code_difficulty.positive: The preserved compatibility interface and batch contract provide clear integration points.
code_difficulty.negative: Architecture-aware probes, correct padding masks, full-catalog scoring, and matched inference serialization require careful implementation.
